solves.reasoning: starts from the premise(전제) / interconnections(상호연결) / appreciation(이해) → ②
reasoned(합리적) judgments / grasp(파악) forces / consideration(고려) → ③
inextricably(불가분) / discrimination(차별) / layout(배치) → ④
③irrational은 원문 reasoned의 반의어 — 문맥상 부적절
②disconnections은 원문 interconnections의 반의어 — 상호연결을 단절로 바꾸면 부적절
④virtual은 원문 physical의 반의어 — 물리적 환경이 맞고 가상 환경은 부적절
some ____ of spatial circumstances → appreciation(이해/인식). distribution/discrimination/organization 문맥 부적합
make ____ business judgments → reasoned(합리적인). awareness/consequences/variations 문맥 부적합
starts from the ____ that → premise(전제). arrangements/circumstances/relationships는 that절 접속에 부적합
inextricably(불가분하게) ≈ inseparably. 나머지 모두 다른 의미
appreciation(이해/인식) ≈ understanding. criticism/rejection/measurement 다른 의미
grasp(이해하다) ≈ comprehend. release/ignore/simplify 다른 의미
premise(전제) ↔ conclusion(결론). assumption/foundation/basis는 동의어/유사어
significance(중요성) ↔ triviality(하찮음). importance/relevance/weight는 동의어/유사어
(A) grasp implications=이해하다 (B) grasp railing=붙잡다 → ①
spread out or arranged over an area → distribution(분포)
arrangements, variations, and __(interconnect): 병렬 명사 복수 → interconnections
taking into __(consider): take into consideration 숙어 → consideration
where to find food, how to ____, and the like → get to work places (일상 공간 활동)
without some awareness of ____, it is difficult to make reasoned judgments → the significance of spatial relationships
